name: Gravity
description: A steady pull. The arrow shows which way.
_help: Shmup only. pull: px/s the ship is dragged toward the arrow; the same at every level, and well under the ship's speed so you can always fly against it (npm run check:shmup checks this). shiftEvery: seconds between direction swaps; 0 = never (level 1). The arrow blinks for the last second before a swap. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine.
